title: Act: Add rejectExecution to the admin client
summary: Export rejectExecution in client.ts after retryExecution.
description: Add rejectExecution(token, id) to game/frontend/src/api/client.ts after retryExecution (ends near L105), copying the approveExecution pattern with the /reject path.
acceptance_criteria: Given the file is saved, when tsc --noEmit runs, then rejectExecution is exported with signature (token: string, id: string) => Promise<ExecutionInfo>.
Given a call, when it runs, then it delegates to adminRequest with method POST and the /reject path.

steps.action: Add an exported function rejectExecution(token: string, id: string) that returns adminRequest<ExecutionInfo> for the path /api/v1/admin/executions/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/reject with { method: 'POST' }, placed directly after retryExecution and before listExecutions.
steps.expected: client.ts exports rejectExecution and npx tsc --noEmit in game/frontend passes.
